en.title: Maximum Sum by Sign-Flip Pairs
en.description:
Each operation picks two distinct positions and multiplies both by −1; operations can be repeated. Find the maximum sum the array can reach.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: n (2≤n≤200000), n integers (−10⁹..10⁹). From the source problem's constraints.
en.output: Output the maximum sum, using a 64-bit integer.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
